cases.sourceText: Met with Priya at 2pm to review the Q3 budget. She flagged that marketing spend is 12% over forecast, mostly due to the trade show in Austin. We agreed to freeze new marketing spend until October and revisit after the conference ROI numbers come in.

cases.candidateSummary: Dentist appointment moved to Monday 9am.

cases.sourceText: Idea: build a small CLI tool that watches a directory for new markdown files and auto-generates a table of contents at the top of each one on save.
cases.candidateSummary: Idea for a CLI tool that watches a folder and auto-inserts a table of contents into markdown files, also supports PDF export and cloud sync.

cases.sourceText: Recipe note: the sourdough came out dense again. Next time try increasing hydration to 78% and extending bulk ferment by an hour.
cases.candidateSummary: Sourdough was dense; next attempt: 78% hydration, one more hour of bulk fermentation.
